image_description: A grand pipe organ facade featuring five distinct towers of vertical silver metal pipes arranged symmetrically within an ornate, polished wooden case. The central tower is the tallest, flanked by progressively shorter towers. Decorative gold finials and lighting fixtures crown the wooden structures. A decorative balustrade runs along the bottom foreground.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific taxonomic classification of the instrument and distinguish it from other architectural structures.
To ensure the pipes have correct depth relative to the wooden case and do not suffer from 'flatness' or background bleeding.
To check for fusion between adjacent pipes and ensure each pipe is a distinct, continuous cylinder.
To assess the sharpness and realism of the ornate wood details and identify any subtle blurring or smearing.

focus_areas: Uniformity and straightness of vertical pipes
Separation between pipes and wooden casing
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the regularity of the pipe diameters and spacing. AI models often struggle with repeating parallel lines, causing them to wobble or merge. Also, verify if the lighting reflections on the metal pipes are consistent with the light sources visible at the top.
